asserts: No file of the UI kit but its drawing code (charts, sparklines, lit/fx/), design values (theme/) and gallery turns a value into a float with parseFloat, Number(), toFixed() or unary +.

guard.ref: packages/ui/src/components/money-safety.test.ts#has no parseFloat, Number(), toFixed() or unary +value in any of its files

why: garden/no-number-money now judges packages/ui/src strictly with the test's own exclusions; the test runs it strict over packages/ui/src (a disable comment for the rule, or for every rule, counts as a finding, nested configs are not read), asserts no finding and that amount-input-logic.ts, numbers.tsx, primitives.tsx and coins/ were judged, and plants copies to show subfolders are judged, only drawing code and design values are left out, and a silenced float still counts.

asserts: The desk's place (OrderForm.tsx) and replace (EditOrder.tsx) never mint a random client order id, so a retry cannot place a second order.

guard.ref: apps/customer/src/screens/trade/desk/replace-key.test.ts#the desk no longer mints a random number for a place or a replace

why: garden/no-random-request-key is set to { anyRandomUUID: true } for OrderForm.tsx and EditOrder.tsx, so any randomUUID there is a finding (in a callback, a cloid or a field of any name); the test runs it strict over both files (a disable comment counts), asserts no finding and that both were judged, and shows planted random ids in each fire, a silenced one included.

why: An .oxlintrc.json override switches on oxlint's react/no-multi-comp and max-lines (max 600) for VenueSpotDesk.tsx, judged by the lint ratchet; tooling/lint/oxlint-plugin-garden/desk-shape-override.test.mjs shows both fire on planted copies.
